idea-plugin.name: JSON to Java Record
idea-plugin.description:
Paste JSON, get Java records. Works with IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1 and newer (requires Java support).
  • Generates nested record types with correct types (int, long, double, boolean, String, List, Object)
  • Optional Jackson (@JsonProperty) or Gson (@SerializedName) annotations for snake_case and other non-Java names
  • Merges array elements so optional fields become boxed types
  • Insert at the caret, or create a new .java file from the Project view
  • No network access or telemetry; error reports are sent only if you choose to report one
Use it from Tools | Paste JSON as Java Record, the editor Generate menu (Alt+Insert), or the Project view New menu.

action.description: Generate Java records from a JSON document
